function.description: Preferred tool for listing replacement devices and their details. Use this tool for any query about device replacement status, device family, or serial numbers. Filters by Faulty Device Name, Faulty Device Platform, Replacement Device Platform, Faulty Device Serial Number, Replacement Device Serial Number, Device Replacement status, or Product Family. Always call this tool with the provided parameters. If the API returns an empty list when filtering by faultyDeviceSerialNumber, report that no replacement record was found for that serial number — do not ask the user to clarify the identifier.
function.name: api_returnListOfReplacementDevicesWithReplacementDetails

family.description: List of families[Routers, Switches and Hubs, AP]

hasNeighborDevice.description: Filter by whether the faulty device has a neighbor device

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

replacementStatus.description: Device Replacement status filter. Accepts both hyphen and underscore formats (e.g. READY-FOR-REPLACEMENT or READY_FOR_REPLACEMENT). Available values: READY-FOR-REPLACEMENT, REPLACEMENT-IN-PROGRESS, REPLACEMENT-SCHEDULED, REPLACED, ERROR, NETWORK_READINESS_REQUESTED, NETWORK_READINESS_FAILED. Note: MARKED_FOR_REPLACEMENT is a transient internal state not available as a filter. Devices 'marked for replacement' immediately transition to READY-FOR-REPLACEMENT (or NETWORK_READINESS_REQUESTED for fabric devices). To find devices that were marked for replacement, query READY-FOR-REPLACEMENT and NETWORK_READINESS_REQUESTED.

siteId.description: Site Id to filter replacement devices by site

sortBy.description: SortBy this field. SortBy is mandatory when order is used.

sortOrder.description: Sort order for the sortBy field. Available values: ASC, DESC

creationTime.description: Date and time of marking the device for replacement

faultyDeviceId.description: Unique identifier of the faulty device

id.description: Unique identifier of the device replacement resource

neighbourDeviceId.description: Unique identifier of the neighbor device to create the DHCP server

networkReadinessTaskId.description: Unique identifier of network readiness task

readinesscheckTaskId.description: Unique identifier of the readiness check task for the replacement device

replacementTime.description: Date and time of device replacement

workflowFailedStep.description: Step in which the device replacement failed

workflowId.description: Unique identifier of the device replacement workflow
